notes.title: Some Malkyrs card readers are waiting for an update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A first update to talk about the Malkyrs card readers.

Some of them (the last produced and sold) are currently not able to read and edit the card's information with the new version of the game. You can find here two pictures helping you to identify them (the ones with a USB port aligned with "Malkyrs" are fully functional, the others with a USB port aligned diagonally with the logo are not functional):
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35768527/bf332f98cae4d2de30205cf69fdbec278bb09e9c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35768527/0aee65e9a1fbc766a234b61a965804002e935775.jpg[/img][/url]          [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35768527/cef794e541b051053913561df56756d5a30a7b9e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35768527/c1b8bcf0f7803d2cbf0583abea9ee6c1c0e11534.jpg[/img][/url]

We are working hard to propose you a firmware update to reestablish all the features. Until that, the Malkyrs Reader app was published on the Android Play Store. It will work with any Android smartphone equipped with the NFC technology.

Some details on what these readers can do or not:

They can:
[list]
[*] Read the action cards from every editions
[*] Read the champion cards from Turmoil on Oligar (4th edition) and Raids on Oligar (5th edition)
[/list]

They cannot:
[list]
[*] Read the champions coming from the Beta edition, Arenas of Eternity (1st edition) and Maden Ablaze (2nd edition)
[*] Update the cards
[*] Upgrade the cards
[/list]

We will update you on the development progress by next week (Starting 9th September 2019)
